description: A requirement to conduct sample file reviews of at least 10 complaint files as part of internal audit procedures to assess compliance and quality.

name: Complaint Response Timeliness Testing
description: A mandatory testing obligation to verify that complaints are handled within required timeframes as part of internal audit procedures.

name: Compensation Appropriateness Review
description: A requirement to audit and verify that compensation awards made to complainants are appropriate and justified based on the complaint circumstances.

name: FCA Disclosure Accuracy Testing
description: A mandatory testing obligation to ensure that all disclosures made to the FCA regarding complaint handling are accurate and complete.

name: Financial Conduct Authority
description: The UK financial regulator responsible for supervising complaint handling procedures and conducting periodic thematic reviews. The FCA has authority to issue consent orders for violations.

name: Internal Audit Testing Program
description: A systematic internal control mechanism comprising annual testing of complaint handling procedures, including file sampling, timeliness verification, and compensation review to ensure ongoing compliance.

name: FCA Periodic Complaint Thematic Review
description: An external supervisory control mechanism whereby the FCA conducts periodic thematic reviews of complaint handling practices to assess regulatory compliance and identify systemic issues.

name: FCA Consent Order Authority
description: The FCA's regulatory enforcement power to issue consent orders when violations of complaint handling requirements are identified during supervision.

name: Policy Review and Updates
description: A policy governing the periodic review and update cycle for banking policies. The policy establishes an annual review frequency with provisions for ad-hoc reviews triggered by regulatory changes from the FCA. Last review was conducted on 2026-06-01 with the next scheduled review on 2027-06-01.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon FCA change)

name: Annual Policy Review Requirement
description: A mandatory requirement that policies be reviewed on an annual basis, or more frequently if triggered by changes in FCA regulations or guidance.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon FCA change)

name: Ad-Hoc Policy Review Upon Regulatory Change
description: A provision requiring that policies be reviewed and updated outside the standard annual cycle whenever the FCA issues new regulatory changes, guidance, or requirements.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon FCA change)

name: Financial Conduct Authority
description: The UK financial regulator whose regulatory changes and guidance trigger ad-hoc policy reviews outside the standard annual cycle.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon FCA change)

description: The role responsible for authoring, maintaining, and updating this complaints and compensation policy. Documented as the author of all policy versions from initial creation through the most recent alignment of escalation and compensation frameworks.

name: Customer Service Department
description: The department responsible for handling customer interactions and service delivery as referenced in the related documents section of this policy framework.

name: Escalation Matrix
description: A documented control mechanism that defines the escalation pathways and decision trees for handling complaints and issues within the organization.

name: Complaint Resolution Guide
description: A formal policy document that provides guidance on the procedures and standards for resolving customer complaints within the organization.

name: Head of Customer Service
description: Executive role responsible for approving customer service policies and procedures. This role holds accountability for customer-facing service delivery and policy compliance within the customer service function.

name: Head of Compliance
description: Executive role responsible for approving compliance policies and ensuring regulatory adherence. This role holds accountability for the bank's compliance framework and regulatory obligations.

description: Senior executive role with ultimate accountability for policy approval and organizational governance. The CEO provides final sign-off on significant policy documents.
